🆕 New (Published: March 29, 2026)

Starting April 11, 2026 (Reiwa 8), the closure days and hours of two tourist information offices in Hanno will change.

Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association (inside Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry): Closed every Sunday (open on national holidays; closed on substitute holidays) and during year-end/New Year holidays. Hours: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

Hanno Station Tourist Information Office "Puratto Hanno": Closed during year-end/New Year holidays and April 1–10, 2026 (Reiwa 8) for renovation. Hours: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. (same hours weekdays, weekends, and holidays).

Note: Manhole card distribution and Eagle Bus pass sales will no longer be available at Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association.
